title: 13 non-parked host books fail a standalone certify on dev 9ea276da0; train certifies (--lane, not transitive) never reach them
detail: Found by C8's persvati certify --affected-by the 50 host books lane host-cert-reds touched (certify-20261008T214746Z-238935, run-20261008T214711Z-4852). None of the failures comes from the attach includes that lane adds; each names a symbol or form the book's own world lacks. Classes: (1) definterface forms in host books whose world lacks books/definterface (relocated declarations, row 8): bp-receipt-journal-host, native-live-status-host, reader-host, store-identity-host, tls-reload-host, workflow-host; (2) a declaration or keystone naming something defined in a book the host book does not include: interfaces (fn-send-window-octets, slow-reader-iso), cost-host (fn-reader-chunk), owner-served-carried (fn-owner-cfg-capture-state-by-definition, reconfig-host); (3) host functions calling functions from host files they do not include-book: bp-native-app-host (fn-owner-config), bp-release-owner-host (fn-sn-node), owner-retain-host (fn-owner-install-effects); (4) host/native/heap selected as a book (raw file; selection defect).
fix: Each non-parked host book certifies in its own world: include-book what it uses (by transformation where the class repeats: a tool that adds the definterface include to every host book holding a definterface, and the defining host/book include for each undefined name, read from host_check's world). Then add a gate that certifies every non-parked host book standalone (or I's transitive train certify covers it).
